independent_acceptance: Codex: code review, independent temporary-filesystem probes, final focused suite, mutation failure-cause review, preservation audit.
scope: Accept the native same-cache huggingface_hub shared blob layout in the recovery verifier; do not change installation pins, recovery state, frozen scientific code or matrix identity.

cache_contract.shared: snapshot -> same-repository blobs/<ETag> -> ../../blobs/<Xet first two hex>/<64 lower-case hex Xet hash> regular payload
cache_contract.store_marker: same-cache blobs/.huggingface-shared-blobs, regular file containing exactly ASCII 1 followed by LF (hex 31 0a)
cache_contract.integrity: Hash payload bytes against original repository blob ETag: SHA-256 for 64 hex, Git blob SHA-1 for 40 hex. The Xet store name is not the expected content digest.
cache_contract.path_checks: Require real directories below the cache root, same repository first hop and exact shared-store second hop. Reject further symlinks, escapes, dangling links and invalid markers.

mutants.name: M1-store-name-as-expected-digest
mutants.change: the Xet store name replaces the repo ETag as the expected digest

mutants.name: M2-follow-arbitrary-links
mutants.change: any link chain that ends in a regular file is accepted (realpath)

mutants.name: M3-marker-unchecked
mutants.change: the version-1 store marker is neither required nor read

mutants.name: M4-prefix-unchecked
mutants.change: the two-hex prefix directory need not equal the hash start

mutants.name: M5-store-directories-followed
mutants.change: store and prefix directories are followed (lstat of the final name only)

mutation_checks.causal_review: M1 fails ETag-vs-Xet positive and corrupted-payload cases; M2 fails actual escape acceptance; M3 fails absent/incorrect/symlinked marker acceptance; M4 fails prefix mismatch acceptance; M5 fails prefix/store directory escape acceptance. Additional M5 diagnostic-string failures are not used as causal evidence.

node_observed.source: User-provided node stdout and subsequent symlink-chain inspection
